name: chartSize
label: Chart size
description: Sets the size of the chart.

name: headingPosition
label: Heading Position
description: Position for the metric label.

name: scoreSize
label: Score size
description: Adjusts the size of the score displayed in the visualization.

name: scoreAlignment
label: Score alignment
description: Align the elements based on value.

name: scoreIcon
label: Score icon
description: Add icon to be shown in front of the score value.

name: iconStyle
label: Icon style
description: Defines the style of the icon. When the chosen style has a background, the color is applied to the background. Otherwise, the color is applied to the icon itself.

name: showScoreDate
label: Show Score Date
description: Shows the date of the score.

name: showZero
label: Show 0 when no data available
description: Choose the display format when there is no value in the selected dataset or for the configuration.

name: enableDrilldown
label: Enable drilldown
description: When selected, enables an event handler to allow users to click a visualization value or section.

name: sparklineStyle
label: Sparkline style
description: Style of sparkline chart.

name: showChange
label: Show Change
description: Shows the change compared to the previous score or period.

name: showChangePercentage
label: Show change percentage
description: Shows the change percentage compared to the previous score or period.

name: showTarget
label: Show Targets
description: Displays the global target value. Target will only appear if it is defined for the indicator.

name: showGapPercentage
label: Show gap percentage
description: Shows the percentage between the current value and the target value.

name: showSparkline
label: Show Sparkline
description: Shows a line graph representing the change over time.

name: showMetricLabel
label: Show metric label
description: Shows the metric label.

name: showScoreUpdateTime
label: Show score update time
description: Displays the time of the last update of the single score.

name: useRelativeScoreTime
label: Use relative score time
description: Uses relative time to show the last update of the single score.

name: headerTitle
label: Chart title
description: Title for the visualization.

name: applyDateRange
label: Apply date range
description: Allows date range filter from filter component or manual configuration to be applied to data visualization.

name: autoAggregatePeriods
label: Automatically aggregate periods
description: Automatically picks the best aggregation period when a date filter is used. Affects only this visualization and does not change the indicator's default aggregation period. Clear the checkbox to always use the indicator's default period.

name: scoreType
label: Show data for selected period as
description: Defines indicator aggregation logic on how scores for selected period will be shown.

name: wrapElements
label: Wrap elements
description: Moves elements to a new line if there’s not enough space. If not selected, elements will be cut off.
